function createMutations(store): MutationMap;

Defined in: core/store/mutations.ts:25

Builds the mutation map bound to store. Domain groups are spread into one flat map — key collisions would silently overwrite, so each group owns a disjoint prefix of MUTATIONS by convention (theme., media., …).

Parameters

store

Store

The Store instance the mutators close over.

Returns

MutationMap

The composed MutationMap.
